title: Add Flyway migrations V1-V4 (users, docker_hosts, stacks, stack_versions)
description: backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_users.sql .. V4__create_stack_versions.sql based on the HANDOFF.md drafts, with these decided changes: every TIMESTAMP column becomes TIMESTAMPTZ; FKs to users keep no ON DELETE (RESTRICT); stacks.host_id and stack_versions.stack_id keep ON DELETE CASCADE. gen_random_uuid() without pgcrypto. Follow CLAUDE.md Flyway rules (one migration per table, never edit applied ones).
acceptance_criteria:
- V1-V4 apply cleanly in the Testcontainers baseline; flyway_schema_history shows 4 successful versions
- Integration test (JdbcTemplate against the Testcontainers DB) verifies: timestamp columns are timestamptz; users.username unique; stacks (host_id, name) unique; deleting a docker_host cascades to its stacks and their stack_versions; deleting a user referenced by a host/stack/version fails
- ./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify passes
- HANDOFF.md review notes on TIMESTAMP and ON DELETE marked as decided; Code Map updated

title: Add Flyway, PostgreSQL datasource and Testcontainers test baseline
description:
In backend/pom.xml add spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, flyway-core, flyway-database-postgresql (separate artifact since Flyway 10), postgresql (runtime), and Testcontainers (postgresql + junit-jupiter, via Spring Boot's testcontainers support). Configure application.yml exactly as the HANDOFF.md draft (ddl-auto: validate, open-in-view: false, flyway locations classpath:db/migration, baseline-on-migrate false, validate-on-migrate true) with database/user 'shipir' and password ${DB_PASSWORD}.
Create a reusable test baseline: a @TestConfiguration with a @ServiceConnection PostgreSQLContainer (postgres:16-alpine) that integration tests import, and switch the context-load test to it. No migrations yet (next task) — create backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/ with a .gitkeep if Flyway needs the directory.
acceptance_criteria:
- Context-load integration test starts against a Testcontainers Postgres 16 and passes with ./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify
- No test requires a locally running Postgres or DB_PASSWORD
- application.yml matches the HANDOFF.md draft (names adjusted to shipir); no secrets committed
- Running the app with the dev compose DB up and DB_PASSWORD set starts cleanly (./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml spring-boot:run)
- README/CLAUDE.md note that Docker must be running for tests; Code Map updated

title: Add Maven wrapper and Spring Boot application skeleton
description:
In backend/: add the Maven wrapper (mvnw, mvnw.cmd, .mvn/wrapper) and turn pom.xml into a Spring Boot project (spring-boot-starter-parent, latest stable GA supporting Java 25; check Maven Central/start.spring.io and pin the exact version). Starters for now: web, websocket, validation, test. No JPA/DB yet (added in the Flyway/Testcontainers task) and no security.
Replace the template Main.java with dev.bethge.shipir.ShipirApplication. Create the package skeleton from the CLAUDE.md architecture tree (common/{config,exception,security,util}, docker, host, compose, config_editor, streaming, auth, permission, audit) using a package-info.java with a one-line Javadoc per package; keep the existing placeholder classes.
Add backend/src/main/resources/application.yml with spring.application.name=shipir and spring.jpa.open-in-view=false placeholder only where it does not require JPA (otherwise leave JPA keys for the DB task).
acceptance_criteria:
- backend/mvnw (executable) and backend/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties exist; ./mvnw -v works without a local Maven install
- pom.xml uses spring-boot-starter-parent with a pinned GA version, java.version 25, spring-boot-maven-plugin
- dev.bethge.shipir.ShipirApplication exists; Main.java is removed
- package-info.java in every package of the architecture tree
- A @SpringBootTest context-load test passes: ./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify is green
- README.md backend setup and CLAUDE.md Build & Test use ./mvnw (javac workaround removed); Code Map updated
- HANDOFF.md open decisions: Maven vs Gradle, Java/Spring Boot version (with exact version) and MVC vs WebFlux marked decided

title: Add docker-compose.dev.yml for local PostgreSQL 16
description: Repo root docker-compose.dev.yml with a single service: postgres:16-alpine, database and user 'shipir', port 5432, named volume, healthcheck (pg_isready). The password comes from DB_PASSWORD via a .env file: commit .env.example with a placeholder, add .env to the root .gitignore. No password in plain text in tracked files.
acceptance_criteria:
- docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config validates
- docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d starts a healthy container; psql -U shipir -d shipir connects
- .env is gitignored, .env.example is committed with DB_PASSWORD=<placeholder>
- README setup section explains copying .env.example to .env and starting the DB; Code Map updated

title: Project skeleton: Spring Boot backend that builds and runs its tests
description:
Build-order step 1 (HANDOFF.md). Turn backend/ into a Spring Boot app with the package structure from CLAUDE.md, a local Postgres via docker-compose.dev.yml, Flyway migrations V1-V4 and a Testcontainers test baseline, so every later feature starts from a green build.

Decisions (2026-10-21): Maven with wrapper (mvnw); Java 25 (current LTS) with the latest stable Spring Boot GA; classic Spring MVC + WebSocket/STOMP (no WebFlux); all timestamp columns TIMESTAMPTZ; FKs to users stay RESTRICT (no ON DELETE), users are deactivated rather than deleted later.
Assumption: database and user are named 'shipir' (the handoff's 'dockerpanel' was the old working title).

In scope: build tooling, Spring Boot app class, package skeleton, base application.yml, dev compose file, Flyway + V1-V4, Testcontainers baseline, docs/Code Map updates.
Out of scope: Spring Security/auth, JPA entities and repositories (they come with each feature), docker-java, frontend changes, CI pipeline.
acceptance_criteria:
- ./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify passes on a fresh clone with only JDK 25 and Docker installed
- docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up starts Postgres 16 and the app starts against it with Flyway applying V1-V4
- README setup section and CLAUDE.md Build & Test / Code Map describe the real commands
- HANDOFF.md records the decisions above

description: Set up the React frontend described in CLAUDE.md: Vite + React + TypeScript, pnpm, feature-oriented folders, React Query. Monaco is decided but only added when the first editor feature is built.
acceptance_criteria:
- frontend/ created with pnpm (Vite react-ts template), package.json has packageManager pnpm@9.14.4 and engines.node >=24; pnpm-lock.yaml committed-ready
- Folder structure: src/app (providers, router/root), src/features/{containers,hosts,stacks} (placeholder index.ts each), src/shared (api client, ui, lib)
- @tanstack/react-query installed and a QueryClientProvider wired in src/app
- A small typed fetch wrapper in src/shared/api that calls relative /api paths
- Vite dev server proxies /api -> http://localhost:8080 and /ws -> ws://localhost:8080 (ws: true)
- Vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom set up, with one passing smoke test that renders App
- Scripts: dev, build, preview, lint, test; pnpm lint, pnpm test --run and pnpm build all pass
- Template demo content (counter, logos, App.css demo styles) removed; App shows a minimal Shipir placeholder
- frontend/.gitignore covers node_modules and dist
close_reason: Scaffolded frontend/ (Vite, React 19, TS, pnpm, React Query, apiFetch, proxy, Vitest+RTL); lint/test/build pass

title: E2E testing with Playwright against the mocked-API frontend
description:
Give the project browser-level e2e tests so user-visible flows are verified end to end in the UI. Used by the next-task-e2e skill for every UI task.

Decisions (2026-10-21): Playwright, Chromium only; tests run against the Vite frontend with /api mocked at the network level (page.route). Full-stack e2e (real Spring Boot + Postgres) comes later, once the backend serves endpoints.

In scope: Playwright install/config in frontend/, shared API-mock fixture, a smoke spec, pnpm scripts, docs.
Out of scope: full-stack e2e, other browsers, visual regression, CI pipeline.
acceptance_criteria:
- From frontend/, pnpm e2e runs the Playwright suite headless against the Vite app and passes
- Specs live in frontend/e2e/, shared mocks in frontend/e2e/fixtures/, matching .claude/skills/next-task-e2e/SKILL.md
- Unit tests (pnpm test) and e2e tests stay separate
- README and CLAUDE.md explain how to install the browser and run e2e
